parameters.jsCode: const body = $json.body ?? $json; const opportunity = body.opportunity ?? {}; const pkg = body.package ?? {}; if (!opportunity.opportunity_id) throw new Error('opportunity.opportunity_id é obrigatório'); if (!Array.isArray(pkg.entries) || pkg.entries.length === 0) throw new Error('package.entries é obrigatório'); const clientDocs = pkg.entries.filter(item => item.source_owner === 'client'); const stepDocs = pkg.entries.filter(item => item.source_owner === 'step'); const unknownDocs = pkg.entries.filter(item => item.source_owner === 'unknown'); return [{json:{...body, opportunity, package:pkg, classification:{client_documents:clientDocs, step_documents:stepDocs, unknown_documents:unknownDocs, groups:pkg.summary?.groups ?? {}, ignored:pkg.ignored ?? []}}}];

const c=$json.classification; return [{json:{status:'package_received', opportunity:$json.opportunity, package_summary:$json.package.summary, classification_summary:{client_documents:c.client_documents.length,step_documents:c.step_documents.length,unknown_documents:c.unknown_documents.length,groups:c.groups,ignored:c.ignored.length},agents_requested:$json.opportunity.agents ?? [],next_step:'Executar agentes técnico, comercial, contratual e cobertura usando os documentos classificados.'}}];
